source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 930 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 930 was established by Ordinance No. 29536, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 12, 2014. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 930 is established on property located at the northeast corner of Hillcrest Road and Walnut Hill Lane. The size of PD 930 is approximately 8.57 acres. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 930A: development plan.

(2) Exhibit 930B: landscape plan. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For local utilities limited to utility services, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 930A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R- 7.5(A) Single Family District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) The following additional main use is permitted by right:

-- Local utilities limited to utility services. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-7.5(A) Single Family District apply.

(b) Local utilities limited to utility services.

(1) Front yard. Minimum front yard along Aberdeen Avenue is 10 feet. A fence with a maximum height of 10 feet may be located within a front yard.

(2) Height. Maximum structure height is 37 feet. No portion of the structure may be located above the residential proximity slope.

(3) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 45 percent. Aboveground structures and surface pavement are included in lot coverage calculations. Underground structures are not included in a lot coverage calculations.

(4) Stories. For a pump station, maximum number of stories above grade is one. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) In general.

(A) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(B) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(b) Local utilities limited to utility services.

(1) Except as provided in this subsection, landscaping must be provided in accordance with the additional provisions in Section 51A-4.212(4)(E)(i) and as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 930B). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(2) An earthen berm must be provided along the east Property line in the location shown on the development plan and landscape plan.

(3) Before the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for a local utilities limited to utility services use, a detailed landscape plan that complies with this section, the Exhibit 930B landscape plan, and the following requirements must be submitted to and approved by the building official.

(A) A detailed landscape plan must include:

(i) An inventory of all landscaping being installed, including type, size, color, and/or caliper inches.

(ii) A list and the location of all trees being preserved.

(iii) A list and the location of all seriously injured trees being removed and the type and location of the minimum two caliper inch approved replacement tree that will be planted within 20 feet of where the seriously injured tree is removed.

(iv) An irrigation plan with specifications detailing the schedule of irrigation.

(B) Trees listed on the detailed landscape plan must be selected from the approved replacement trees in Section 51A-10.134.

(C) The inventory of landscaping on the detailed landscape plan may be adjusted at the time of installation if the building official determines that the adjustment will not compromise the perennial evergreen hedge screening. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) For local utilities limited to utility services, facade walls must be brick veneer, architectural cast concrete, or a combination of these materials.

(b) For local utilities limited to utility services, fencing must be constructed of wrought iron or a similar decorative metal.

(c) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(d) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29536)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-930.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29536)
